extension.name: ExtraWatch Agent Plugin
extension.author: ExtraWatch Agent by CodeGravity.com - http://www.extrawatch.com
extension.description: ExtraWatch allows you to watch your website visitors and bots in real-time. Especially their IP addresses, countries they come from, geographical location on a map, which pages they are viewing, their browser and operating system, it creates daily and all-time stats from these information plus unique, pageload and total hits statistics. Furthermore, you can block harmful IP addresses, see blocked attempts stats, evaluate the trend charts, and create goals based on many parameters. In the frontend, it can show the top countries information and visit counts for certain periods of time.
